chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Sorting out dates: Buck's death, Germany and London
summary: Nierenberg tries to square Buck dying in 1955 with Bubbles' time abroad; Bubbles recalls going to London from Germany for BBC television and Memories of Jolson.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So you left for Germany in '49.
Started performing -- now, Buck had passed away. But you didn't come back for his funeral, though.
Look what you're saying now. Buck died in 1955, I told ya, if I come back in '53, what did you say?
I thought he died while you were in Europe.
Yeah. That's why I said, look what you said. Then I got back in '57 then, didn't I? Was it 1957?
So then you were in Europe for eight years. If you left in '49 and got back in '57, you were there for eight years.

I wasn't there that long, I don't think I was there that long -- I went to London from Germany in '53 to do the what's-their-name shows over there -- variety television, BBC. And I also went to do "Memories of Josie" show -- I can't think who was in this
